nutrition.citation: Yeo PLQ, Bi X, Yeo MTY, Henry CJ. Energy Content and Nutrient Profiles of Frequently Consumed Meals in Singapore. Foods. 2021;10(7):1659.
nutrition.note: 45 meals bought from a Kopitiam food court in Singapore and measured by near-infrared spectroscopy (Calorie Answer). Tables 1-3 give the portion weight and energy, protein, fat and carbohydrate per 100 g; yeo2021.csv transcribes them with the per-serving values of Tables 4-6 beside them for cross-checking.

nutrition.citation: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central: Survey Foods (FNDDS), release 2024-10-31.
nutrition.note: U.S. recipes, not Singapore ones. Used only where Yeo et al. (2021) has no comparable dish; fndds.csv holds the rows used, extracted by extract_fndds.py.
